BiblicalUsage: The word names the winding stairs that led up through the temple Solomon built, from the middle chamber to the third. It appears only once, in the description of how the house of God was put together.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Scripture's care over a staircase shows God notices the way up into His presence, and no step toward Him is wasted.
